findings.requirement: Aggregate integrity must bind acceptance counts and blocking findings to the actual validated review or audit artifacts; fabricated aggregate fields must not authorize advancement.
findings.evidence: scripts/mros/advance_program.py::_validate_aggregate validates only aggregate-level critical, major, unknown, and count fields. It does not validate each aggregate item against the applicable review/audit schema, recompute severity counts from item findings, verify item verdict consistency, or require item-level evidence references. A caller can supply positive denominators and a non-empty list of arbitrary items while setting critical=major=unknown=0 and decision=PASS, allowing authorize() to advance if other inputs are forged consistently.
findings.falsifier: A complete aggregate-level validation path proves every item against the relevant schema and receipt/population bindings, recomputes all severity totals and verdict-derived blocking conditions from those items, and rejects any mismatch before advancement.
findings.recommended_repair_scope: Make advancement consume independently validated aggregate artifacts or re-run complete item validation and recomputation at the authority boundary. Reject mismatched item counts, verdicts, findings, severity totals, roles, jobs, receipts, population membership, and evidence bindings; add regression tests for fabricated PASS aggregates containing blocking or malformed items.
